builds.name: switch2mac's engine
builds.about: switch2mac's own engine: Performance mode, the preparing screen, the run-time shaders taken from the dump. Fastest on M1 and M2 so far.

builds.name: nxnative's engine
builds.about: Upstream nxnative with switch2mac's overlay and key-2 settings: its own Switch 2 shader translator and shared terrain tiles (less memory). Suits M3 and newer.

builds.name: mkw-neo (low memory)
builds.about: MenAtCafe's nxnative port tuned to fit 8 GB (MIT): a race holds about 4 GB, 40-58 fps on a MacBook Neo, every course played. The build for Macs with 16 GB or less and for fanless MacBook Airs.

builds.name: Thijs2004's 1.8.0 version
builds.about: Thijs2004's nxnative port for Mario Kart World 1.8.0 (update v917504) (MIT): the only build here for a dump with the 1.8.0 update.

choose.why: Your dump has the 1.8.0 update: this is the build that plays it
16 GB or less: mkw-neo holds a race in about 4 GB (the other builds need 11-20 GB)
MacBook Air: the lightest build keeps a fanless Mac cool and fast
Macs with 17-23 GB: nxnative's build needs much less memory than switch2mac's (which grows past 20 GB in long sessions)
M3 and newer Macs run nxnative's shaders better
M1 and M2 Macs with 24 GB or more run switch2mac's build faster (about 58 fps against 47 on an M1 Max)
